source_audits.source_name: Planning permissions on the London Development Database (LDD)
source_audits.publisher: Greater London Authority / London Development Database / relevant London planning authority
source_audits.attribution_requirements: Attribute Greater London Authority, London Development Database, and relevant London planning authority; preserve OGL v3 notice.
source_audits.coverage_years_checked: Completed LDD planning-permissions rows from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19, with archive workbooks retained under the London Datastore LDD dataset.
source_audits.update_frequency: One-off archived Datastore workbook; LDD was replaced by Planning London Datahub and is not treated as a live feed here.
source_audits.geographic_scope: Greater London LDD point rows from planning authorities.
source_audits.granularity: Planning-permission/scheme row, with optional related non-residential floorspace and bedroom workbook row references.
key_fields_used: Date work commenced on site (Started Date)
required_caveats: LDD rows are administrative planning/development records and should not be presented as independent evidence of construction, opening, occupation, service delivery, or current use.
The LDD Completed Date is source-defined and has no single formal definition in the notes.
Planning permission, work-start, administrative completion-status date, and real-world opening/occupation are separate facts.
Coordinates are LDD point locations from Easting/Northing fields; they are not footprints or precise entrance locations.
Figures describe the permission row and may differ from unaffected uses, phases, split permissions, later amendments, or the final built form.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use selected rows only as candidate LDD administrative completion-status milestones with visible provenance and caveats.

dedupe_fields: prior round132 candidate pack as a fallback if corpus ingestion is incomplete
same fields inside the round135 batch scan
filters: Date construction completed (Completed Date) between 2008-01-01 and 2026-05-19
BNG Easting/Northing present and within a broad Greater London range
Minor domestic and administrative-only rows excluded unless high-signal/large-development overrides apply
Sorted by signal score, then date and workbook row; capped at 1000
